boundary_condition: Applies only to hotel rooming/sleeping-capacity choices; it does not set the destination, exact party size, travel dates, property, or nightly budget.
condition: When booking hotel lodging for multiple travelers or when room/bed setup is being specified, with no explicit contrary configuration given.
default_action: Look first for a two-unit sleeping arrangement: a two-bedroom room or suite, two adjacent rooms, or, when constrained by price or availability, a room with two queen beds.
exception_condition: If the user explicitly specifies a different number of rooms, bedrooms, or beds, or says they are traveling solo and do not need extra sleeping capacity, use that stated configuration instead.
name: Two-unit sleeping setup for multi-person hotel stays
rationale: The independent examples vary in the exact hotel layout, but they consistently ground a reusable synthetic default around needing two sleeping-capacity units rather than a single standard bed setup. The habit is scoped to hotel room configuration, not to the one-off party sizes or budgets mentioned in individual tasks.

source_evidence.contribution: User said they would need a hotel offering “at least two bedrooms,” supporting a two-unit rooming setup.
User requested “a room that has two bedrooms,” supporting a two-bedroom configuration.
User asked for a “two-bedroom suite,” supporting the two-unit hotel setup.
User stated they would need “two adjacent rooms,” supporting two rooming units for a hotel stay.
User considered “a bedroom that has two queens” under a price constraint, supporting two sleeping units as a fallback configuration.

I need a room that has two bedrooms for two people, a full kitchen, a mini fridge and a coffee maker and a microwave.
Great. Do you have a two-bedroom suite? Awesome. Great with balcony. What else and you had him sweet what to buy?
I'm looking to stay from March 23rd to March 28th. There will be five people, and we'll need two adjacent rooms.
Well, I need it under $300 per night, so maybe we could just go with a bedroom that has two queens.
